messages:
alex: Morning async — quick standup. Did: rolled kv-cache patch to canary, validated eviction metrics. Blockers: seeing occasional 504s in the batcher when concurrency spikes, need oncall bandwidth. Today: will tune batcher config and file PR for autoscaler tweak. /cc @oncall

maria: Thanks — can you paste the small log snippet? Also did we see deck's alerts? :eyes:

alex: here's the log I grabbed from canary: ```
ERROR batcher=slot-7: downstream write timeout after 1200ms
  at batcher/slot.go:213
  at runner/dispatch.go:89
```

jin: I saw 2x 504s around 02:14 UTC in eu-west-1, looks correlated with a burst of ~300 small requests. Queue depth spiked from 8 -> 250. I'm on it for 15m.

ops-bot: Incident check: New alert group 'batcher_504_rate' firing 3 times in last 5m. Link: https://sre.dashboard/alerts/1234

maria: Suggest lowering max_batch_size by 25% for canary, and enable a per-route rate limit for the noisy route (/v1/generate). I can open the PR.

alex: +1. I'll add a temporary override in infra: `batcher.max_batch_tokens=1024 -> 768` and `autoscaler.cooldown=30s` for canary.

leo: FYI I scheduled a canary rollback gate if 504 rate > 1% for 10m.

nina: Oncall followup: I'll take postmortem notes if this persists. Also pinging @jin for playbook steps.

jin: grabbing traces and will attach to thread. ETA 20m.

maria: small nit — set KV cache TTL for common prefixes to 10s to reduce a miss-storm on rollouts? Thoughts?

alex: good idea, let's try 8-10s. I'll deploy TTL tweak to canary after the batcher change.

ops-bot: Deploy started: canary-batcher-config v2.3.1 by alex. CI passed.

alex: deploying now, will monitor logs and SLO dashboard.

(monitoring updates)

jin: traces attached: https://sre.traces/abcd1234 — shows queue backlog growth starting at 02:13:48 UTC, then workers catching up after 02:16:02. Root cause looks like concurrent small requests saturating slot allocation.

maria: after deploy, I see 0 alerts for 7m, 504 rate down to 0.3% in canary. :thumbsup:

alex: excellent. Followups: open PR for autoscaler tuning, add a regression test for bursty small-req patterns in the runner; nina can you own the temp postmortem doc?

nina: happy to. I'll create doc and link in #postmortems in 30m.

leo: noting for next oncall rotation: add runbook bullet about `batcher.max_batch_tokens` quick patch and KV TTL short-term tweak.

alex: thanks team. If things look stable by EOD I'll promote to stable. Last check 7142500100
